key.name: toggle-launcher
key.summary: Show or hide the launcher panel
key.description: Global shortcut that opens the panel from anywhere. Alt+Space matches the macOS original's Option+Space; GNOME's own "activate window menu" binding uses the same combination and must be unbound first, which install.sh does for you.

key.name: debounce-ms
key.description: Milliseconds to wait after the last keystroke before sending a request. The macOS launcher sends on every keystroke because it sits next to the API; from other regions a warm round trip is several times longer, so a short debounce is what keeps typing smooth. Fuzzy results appear instantly regardless of this value.

key.name: show-footer-stats
key.summary: Show round trip, cost and model in the footer
